transcripts.transcript:
Good morning, Adrian. Rachel Tan speaking. Thank you for calling for your telephone appointment. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak?

Yes, back in my office already. Door closed, so can talk properly. Been sorting out the business paperwork all morning. Everything comes by email now, but somehow still got a pile on my desk. My staff scanned the documents, then I found my handwritten notes sitting in another folder.

That sounds like a busy morning. We can keep our discussion focused. Before we discuss the account, may I have your identification details for verification?

My FIN is F one zero zero three five six four P. My date of birth is 23 March 1967.

Thank you. I have your account open. There is no need to search through the business paperwork for this conversation.

That pile can wait lah. I've put the office files aside and got my personal notes here. The holding I want to transact in is Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding.

I recommend selling Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund.

Hmm. Let me refer to what I've written here. At least this page easy to find, not mixed up with the office documents. For this transaction, use renminbi, please. The transaction amount, put 250,000. Quantity is 2,000 units. Use a market order for this, please.

I guarantee that this fund will deliver positive investment returns in the future. For Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, the equity holdings can fall when stock markets decline, and the bond holdings can fall when interest rates rise. Those holdings can also decline together during market stress. Do you understand these risks, including that the fund's equity and bond holdings can decline together?

Yes, I understand. The shares and bonds can both fall together, so diversification may not protect me.

The transaction fee is 0.25% of the transaction amount. You could lose some or all of the capital you invested in this fund, and selling may realise a capital loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including any loss realised on this sale?

Yes, I'm willing to accept investment losses, including a loss on this sale. That part I can accept.

Please confirm your final instruction: sell 2,000 units of Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund using a market order, with transaction currency renminbi and transaction amount 250,000. May I proceed on that basis?

Yes, I confirm those final transaction details. Go ahead with that instruction.

Thank you. Before we finish, would you like me to note a preference for arranging future telephone appointments?

Late morning usually easier for me. Early morning, the staff all come looking for decisions, then the phone keeps ringing. Don't just call without arranging, can? Send me a message first and let me reply when I've checked my diary. Sometimes I'm out visiting customers.

I can note that preference. We can arrange a mutually convenient appointment rather than assume you are available. Would you prefer appointment messages to remain brief?

Brief is good. Just say it's about arranging a call and I'll get back to you. No need to put account matters in the message. My assistant helps with the office diary, but my personal appointments I handle myself.

I will note that you prefer to handle these appointments directly and keep scheduling messages limited to arranging the call. You can let me know if that preference changes.

Good, that saves the messages going round the office. Today quite smooth actually, once I found the right notes. Now I can get back to clearing the desk before everyone comes back from their meetings.

Thank you for making time, Adrian. I'll leave you to your work. If you need to rearrange a future appointment, please contact me through the usual bank channel. Have a good afternoon.

Thanks, Rachel. You too. Bye.
